Job Summary The Electric Transmission Digital Solutions Team develops custom applications and data-driven dashboards that help ET use asset data to make informed decisions, track asset health and, support safe, reliable power delivery across the transmission fleet. This internship position will support Electric Transmission Asset Management through the development and maintenance of data systems used for substation equipment monitoring, data analytics, and records management. The selected candidate will assist with gathering business requirements, developing SQL queries and programming code, creating custom applications and dashboards, and supporting data-driven tools that enhance visibility for end users and asset management customers. Under the direction of experienced team members, the intern will gain practical exposure to engineering, compliance, asset management, and the full application development lifecycle, including customer discovery, requirements definition, dashboard development, deployment, and ongoing support. The intern is expected to demonstrate Dominion’s values and uphold the company’s commitment to safety, ethics, and inclusion throughout the assignment. Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience This position requires a foundational understanding of custom application development and the ability to apply academic knowledge to practical business scenarios. The Data Systems Analyst intern should demonstrate the following: Basic knowledge of foundational software concepts Basic knowledge of data structures and programming process flows Solid data analysis and critical thinking skills Basic knowledge of operating system concepts Planning, organizational and project management skills Detail-oriented and quality-focused Good oral and written communication skills Education Requirements Degree: Bachelor's Desired Majors: Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics Graduation Years: Spring 2028 (rising Seniors), Spring 2029 (rising Juniors) Minimum GPA: 2.5 Test Description No Testing Required Export Control Certain positions at Dominion Energy may involve access to information and technology subject to export controls under U.S. law. Compliance with these export controls may result in Dominion Energy limiting its consideration of certain applicants.
